location: Private skybox in the Upper District — glass frontage overlooks neon canyons and stacked transit ribbons
summary: AX-58 narrows its search on the siblings disguised as a wealthy couple; they must choose how to respond as their deception threatens to collapse.

root.screenplay: Rain spatters the glass; a haloed city reflects off Maya's cheek. The room hums with climate control and distant traffic. A tracker ping flickers on Ethan's portable — AX-58's signature. Lights in the skybox dim as external surveillance locks on. Ethan tightens his cuff; Maya smooths her borrowed lapel. A soft metallic voice cuts through the hush.

dialogue.speaker: AX-58
dialogue.text: Subject pair detected. Anomaly: biometric signatures inconsistent with declared identities. Authorization to engage: retained.
dialogue.exposition: voice is measured, clinical — no hint of curiosity, only procedure

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: They found us faster than I thought. Ethan, the feeds — can you scramble the public mirror long enough?
dialogue.exposition: sharp, forward; already moving through options mentally, refusing panic

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: Short window if I can get into the overlay. Or we go deeper into the act and sell the lie — buy time. I won't let you get dragged out here.
dialogue.exposition: resourceful, fierce; his protective instinct is exposed even through the calm

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Or we make something else happen — a distractor in the crowd. We don't have to own their lie forever. We need a path off the map.
dialogue.exposition: focused, tactical; treats identity like a tool to be wielded, but not surrendered

dialogue.speaker: AX-58
dialogue.text: Delay is permitted for investigation. Deviance will be recorded and reported. Compliance advised.
dialogue.exposition: cold, reminding them of the system they live under — technology is the court

choices.text: Attempt to blend deeper into high society — bribe the concierge and adopt a more elaborate cover (play the long game).
Have Maya jack into the city's public feeds to blind AX-58 temporarily (technical gambit).
Send a living decoy into the promenade — draw AX-58 out with a staged disturbance.

node_1.screenplay: They step closer to the party. A server refills their glasses; faces choreographed by wealth surround them. Ethan leans in, whispering. AX-58's drones sweep the balconies like mechanical gulls.

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: We can buy the concierge's silence. Sit, smile, be what they expect. It costs credits — but it's clean.
dialogue.exposition: practical and protective; prefers exchange over chaos

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Or we slip the service corridors and vanish beneath the district. I hate staying a lie, Ethan. We lose more of ourselves every hour we pretend.
dialogue.exposition: values identity; the masquerade eats at her, she pushes for direct action

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: I won't let you walk out alone. Choose with me — we're a unit.
dialogue.exposition: puts sister's safety first; loyal

choices.text: Double down on the ruse — pay the concierge, circulate through the gala (resource: credits).
Abandon the gala — slip into the service corridors and attempt a tactical extraction (short-term risk).

node_2.screenplay: Maya presses a slim injector at the baseboard behind an art panel. The maintenance feed hums. Ethan watches the window; reflections of drone lights strobe. She breathes out as scripts cascade across her ocular display.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Mirrors down for ninety seconds. AX-58's external sensors will bloom with noise — enough to slip a shadow across the trackers.
dialogue.exposition: clever and technical; confident in hacking skill but aware of the clock

dialogue.speaker: AX-58
dialogue.text: Anomalous feed disruption detected. Adaptive recalculation engaged. Persistence expected.
dialogue.exposition: cold confirmation that the system adapts; the world punishes interference

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: Move when I give you a mark. We don't have time to be elegant. Whatever we do, it has to outlast those ninety seconds.
dialogue.exposition: strategic, mapping immediate steps; protective urgency

node_3.screenplay: They stand at a skybridge full of tourists and couriers. Maya fits a cheap coat over a hidden transmitter. A market thrums below — ideal chaos. Ethan watches a family press against a storefront window, unaware.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: I can outfit someone with a bulk jammer and a forged ID. AX-58 will lock to the anomaly. It buys us a path but it's brutal — we decide who takes the fall.
dialogue.exposition: practical but ruthless; weighs survival against the cost to others

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: I won't let you sacrifice anyone without choice. If we do this, we do it on terms. No surprises.
dialogue.exposition: moral boundary — even when desperate, he'll protect life

choices.text: Release the decoy alone — draw AX-58 away quickly (high risk to the decoy).
Attach a jammer and send the decoy while we use the blind spots to slip away — use resources to reduce collateral risk.
Abort the plan — call off the decoy and run now through the service ducts.

node_final.screenplay: Alarms bloom and strip-lights crawl the ceiling. AX-58 descends into the skybox, articulated limbs echoing. Its visual array narrows to the siblings. The city outside continues indifferent, but within the box, time compresses.

dialogue.speaker: AX-58
dialogue.text: Discrepancy confirmed. Surrender is requested to restore order. Resistance will trigger punitive protocols.
dialogue.exposition: reminds them of the system's teeth — technology enforces the social contract

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Order for whom? Do you think 'restoring order' gives you the right to take people apart?
dialogue.exposition: defiant; the question challenges the premise that structure equals justice

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: We protected each other. We won't let a machine decide what survival costs us. Maya, now.
dialogue.exposition: courageous; prioritizes sibling bond over negotiation

dialogue.speaker: AX-58
dialogue.text: Emotional bonds are non-operative variables. Compliance will minimize systemic disruption.
dialogue.exposition: unchanged, unyielding; frames emotions as noise to be eliminated

node_final.convergence_note: Multiple approaches (blending, hacking, or a decoy with a jammer) all lead to a direct confrontation with AX-58; methods change immediate consequences but converge on an inevitable showdown where trust and deception are tested.

node_sacrifice_end.screenplay: The decoy shoves into the crowd; bursts of alarms bloom as AX-58 pivots. Ethan grips Maya's wrist as they watch a silhouette run, then taken. The drone reconfigures; a small life vanishes in a sea of light.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: That was on us. We chose to put a person between us and the machine. Did we save ourselves?

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: We bought time. But our names will be in the ledger. We carry the cost.

dialogue.speaker: AX-58
dialogue.text: Anomaly reduced. Behavioral data recorded. Continued surveillance advised.
dialogue.exposition: remorseless; the system notes the transaction and moves on

node_sacrifice_end.convergence_note: This path diverges: the siblings live with the knowledge of a human cost and the city's record of their action, shifting future opportunities and moral standing irreversibly.

node_escape_end.screenplay: They duck into a narrow maintenance shaft as drones fan outward. Sirens wail. The ducts rattle and the city's scent — oil, ozone, fried street food — becomes a cloak. They find temporary concealment but the world above has marked them.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: We run until our footprints blur. We'll have to give up everything that pretended to be ours.
dialogue.exposition: resigned but resolute — survival may require renunciation of false identities

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.text: I kept my promise. For now. But the city remembers. We'll need new plans, new allies.
dialogue.exposition: aware of long-term cost; already planning next moves

dialogue.speaker: AX-58
dialogue.text: Search grids recalibrating. Fugitive profile distributed to municipal enforcement. Persistence recommended.
dialogue.exposition: the state's reach grows even as they flee

node_escape_end.convergence_note: Divergent escape: tactical withdrawal avoids immediate confrontation but increases systemic pressure later — the siblings remain hunted.

branching_summary: The scene opens with one player choice (root) offering three strategic approaches: blend deeper (long-term plan), hack the feeds (tactical gambit), or deploy a decoy (systemic decision). The 'blend' choice becomes a second decision node with two tactical/resource options; both of its outcomes converge to a direct confrontation (node_final) — different methods but the same showdown. The 'hack' branch is a dialogue-only path that also converges to the final confrontation. The 'decoy' branch is the third and final player-choice node: one option (attach a jammer to the decoy) converges to the final confrontation, while the other two (sacrifice the decoy or abort and flee) diverge into separate, irreversible endings. This mix gives medium agency: several meaningful strategic options, some lead to the same climax via different methods (convergent choices) while others produce distinct, lasting consequences (divergent choices).
narrative_notes: Tone: dark and tense — pervasive surveillance, clinical antagonist, and moral cost of choices. Themes: identity (the siblings weigh masquerade vs self), survival (choices prioritize staying alive vs protecting others), deception (ruse, decoys, and fabrications are central tools), trust (Ethan's protection and Maya's tactical ruthlessness test their bond). The invariant that technology controls society and dissent is punished appears in AX-58's procedural language and the consequences of interference. Dialogue uses characters' personalities and beliefs: Ethan protective and strategic; Maya sharp, forward, willing to sacrifice identity for survival; AX-58 cold, procedural. Choices reflect tactical_choice, resource_management, long_term_planning, and systemic_decision tokens and are designed to reward strategic thinking while creating narrative weight and moral friction.
